title: Encoding and decoding Boolean functions
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $f:(\mathbb{F}_2)^n\to\{-1,1\}$, encode $f$ as a Boolean function on the finite index set of size $2^n$ using the canonical enumerations of the binary cube and the sign cube. Decoding this Boolean function recovers $f$ at every input.
